title: Casting Strength Radio Group
what: A minimal radio-button card UI lets users pick a casting strength, pairing clean typography with playful spell-themed option descriptions.
steps: Call see_design for the frame and read the layout from it: regions, alignment, type scale, corner radii, spacing rhythm.
The media is a clip: name each state you can see (rest, hover, press, open) and the order they occur in.
Build with the project's own stack and tokens; match proportion and hierarchy before matching pixels.
A draft measurement is attached: its phases, moves and palette are measured from the clip; its boxes are a first pass to check against the keyframes.

draft.coverage: flat regions found; boxes and fills are usable as given

confidence.motion: measured: moves of the first keyframe's big parts, edges read at full resolution; dTop and dLeft are the distance in source px
confidence.palette: measured for areas; small things do not reach it
confidence.anchors: measured where the content stands clear of its background (reliable true): the box of everything that is not background at a phase's start and end, and which edges moved; where the content fills the frame the field says so and look_at what=track is the way to read an edge
confidence.elements: draft: flat regions at the first keyframe; nested parts split or merge, text and thin parts are missing; check each box against the keyframe (see_design with at) before trusting it

motion.status: draft measured: draft.phases say when things move, draft.anchors which edges, draft.motion how far; the presets below are only for states the clip never shows
motion.reducedMotion: respect prefers-reduced-motion: no entrance, instant hover

notes.title: Giving motion to a still, honestly

method: Fetch the clip; read size, fps and duration from the container.
Dump frames at 2 fps plus a contact sheet; pick the idle and active moments and dump those at full resolution.

Convert the chosen frames to raw RGB and measure: bounding boxes of every element, exact hex at flat regions, luminance profiles across edges for the lighting, a per-frame luma trace of the moving region for timing.
Build with one unit, --u, equal to one source pixel at the design size, and write every size as calc(N * var(--u)).
Light rounded objects with inset box-shadows on one overlay (rim, near glow, wide falloff); stacked linear gradients show a seam at the corner.
Render the build headless at --u: 1px, crop to the frame, put it beside the source frame, and look. Fix the three largest differences. Repeat.
oneShot: No measured recipe, but a draft: build from draft.elements and draft.motion, look at each keyframe with see_design (at), then call check_rebuild with a screenshot; its regions are reliable, its element rows are as good as the draft boxes.
